news.access module

Shared object-level access rules for the HTML views and the API.

Keeping these rules in one module means the website and the REST API always agree on who can see or change a piece of content.

news.access.editorial_scope(user)[source]

Return a filter for the content an editor is responsible for.

Editors oversee all independent content plus the content of any publisher they edit for.

Parameters:

user (news.models.User) – The editor whose scope is being built.

Returns:

A filter matching independent content and content from the editor’s publishers.

Return type:

django.db.models.Q

news.access.visible_articles(user)[source]

Return the articles user may open.

Everyone sees approved articles. Authors also see their own drafts, and editors see drafts within their editorial scope.

Parameters:

user (news.models.User or django.contrib.auth.models.AnonymousUser) – The current user, who may be anonymous.

Returns:

The articles the user is allowed to view.

Return type:

django.db.models.QuerySet[news.models.Article]

news.access.can_manage(user, item)[source]

Return True if user may edit or delete an article/newsletter.

Editors manage independent items and items from their publishers. Journalists manage only items they wrote. Readers manage nothing.

Parameters:

  • user (news.models.User or django.contrib.auth.models.AnonymousUser) – The current user, who may be anonymous.

  • item (news.models.Article or news.models.Newsletter) – The article or newsletter being checked.

Returns:

True if the user may edit or delete the item.

Return type:

bool

news.access.subscribed_articles(user)[source]

Return approved articles from the reader’s subscriptions.

An article matches if its publisher or its journalist is followed; distinct() stops an article matching both from appearing twice.

Parameters:

user (news.models.User) – The reader whose subscriptions are used.

Returns:

Approved articles from followed publishers and journalists.

Return type:

django.db.models.QuerySet[news.models.Article]
